paragraphs.text: 1. I HAVE beheld the might of this Great Being. Immortal in the midst of tribes of mortals.
His jaws now open and now shut together: much they devour, insatiately chewing.
paragraphs.original: नाना हनू विभृते सं भरेते असिन्वती बप्सती भूर्यत्तः
paragraphs.translit: nānā hanū vibhṛte saṃ bharete asinvatī bapsatī bhūryattaḥ

paragraphs.text: 2. His eyes are turned away, his head is hidden: unsated with his tongue he eats the fuel.
paragraphs.original: गुहा शिरो निहितमृधगक्षी असिन्वन्नत्ति जिह्वया वनानि ।
paragraphs.translit: guhā śiro nihitamṛdhagakṣī asinvannatti jihvayā vanāni |

paragraphs.text: With hands upraised, with reverence in the houses, for him they quickly bring his food together.
paragraphs.original: अत्राण्यस्मै पड्भिः सं भरन्त्युत्तानहस्ता नमसाधि विक्षु
paragraphs.translit: atrāṇyasmai paḍbhiḥ saṃ bharantyuttānahastā namasādhi vikṣu

paragraphs.text: 3. Seeking, as 'twere, his Mother's secret bosom, he, like a child, creeps on through wide-spread bushes.
paragraphs.original: प्र मातुः प्रतरं गुह्यमिच्छन्कुमारो न वीरुधः सर्पदुर्वीः ।
paragraphs.translit: pra mātuḥ prataraṃ guhyamicchankumāro na vīrudhaḥ sarpadurvīḥ |

paragraphs.text: One he finds glowing like hot food made ready, and kissing deep within the earth's realms.
paragraphs.original: ससं न पक्वमविदच्छुचन्तं रिरिह्वांसं रिप उपस्थे अन्तः
paragraphs.translit: sasaṃ na pakvamavidacchucantaṃ ririhvāṃsaṃ ripa upasthe antaḥ

paragraphs.text: 4. This holy Law I tell you, Earth and Heaven: the Infant at his birth devours his Parents.
paragraphs.original: तद्वामृतं रोदसी प्र ब्रवीमि जायमानो मातरा गर्भो अत्ति ।
paragraphs.translit: tadvāmṛtaṃ rodasī pra bravīmi jāyamāno mātarā garbho atti |

paragraphs.text: No knowledge of the God have I, a mortal. Yea, Agni knoweth best, for he hath wisdom.
paragraphs.original: नाहं देवस्य मर्त्यश्चिकेताग्निरङ्ग विचेताः स प्रचेताः
paragraphs.translit: nāhaṃ devasya martyaściketāgniraṅga vicetāḥ sa pracetāḥ

paragraphs.text: 5. This man who quickly gives him food, who offers his gifts of oil and butter and supports him, -
Him with his thousand eyes he closely looks on: thou showest him thy face from all sides, Agni.
paragraphs.original: तस्मै सहस्रमक्षभिर्वि चक्षेऽग्ने विश्वतः प्रत्यङ्ङसि त्वम्
paragraphs.translit: tasmai sahasramakṣabhirvi cakṣe'gne viśvataḥ pratyaṅṅasi tvam

paragraphs.text: 6. Agni, hast thou committed sin or treason among the Gods? In ignorance I ask thee.
paragraphs.original: किं देवेषु त्यज एनश्चकर्थाग्ने पृच्छामि नु त्वामविद्वान् ।
paragraphs.translit: kiṃ deveṣu tyaja enaścakarthāgne pṛcchāmi nu tvāmavidvān |

paragraphs.text: Playing, not playing, he gold-hued and toothless, hath cut his food up as the knife a victim.
7. He born in wood hath yoked his horses rushing in all directions, held with reins that glitter.
The well-born friend hath carved his food with Vasus: in all his limbs he hath increased and prospered.
paragraphs.original: चक्षदे मित्रो वसुभिः सुजातः समानृधे पर्वभिर्वावृधानः
paragraphs.translit: cakṣade mitro vasubhiḥ sujātaḥ samānṛdhe parvabhirvāvṛdhānaḥ
